scripts.copy:html: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ./dist/admin | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ./dist/components | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path './src/*.html' -Destination './dist' -Force; Copy-Item -Path './src/admin' -Destination './dist' -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path './src/components/*.html' -Destination './dist/components' -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run copy:html && npm run copy:assets && npm run postbuild:html
